name: Jina Embeddings v3
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa with LoRA adapters), full attention, no causal mask
notes: Encoder: kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 0, KV formula does not apply. XLM-RoBERTa-large backbone (hidden 1024, 24 layers, 16 heads, vocab 250002, 8194 max_position_embeddings) with LoRA adapters for 5 tasks: retrieval.query, retrieval.passage, separation, classification, text-matching. LoRA rank 4, alpha 1. Matryoshka dimensions [32,64,128,256,512,768,1024] — can truncate to any of these with minimal quality loss. Rotary embeddings (base 20000). Task-specific prefixes required: 'Represent the query for retrieving evidence documents: ' for queries, 'Represent the document for retrieval: ' for passages. CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial). GGUF and ONNX ports exist.
